work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act addresses the Franciscan general chapter before its election. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF154-158) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF29780-29782 reads: HABITA AD FRATRES HINOBBS ORDINIS S. FRANCISCI DIB X HAII MDCCCLV1. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita ad Fratres Minores ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
